# M147 — The rough edges

## Goal

[tui-identity-2026-10.md](../design/tui-identity-2026-10.md) §2, R1–R10:
ten defects a live drive found, each against `docs/design/tui.md` as
written. No change of taste and no new dependency. Most fixes live with
the producer (tool-fs, tool-bash, core, permissions, the command specs),
because after M123 the TUI names no tool and no plugin.

## Bricks, in build order

1. **Failing tests first**, one per defect, in the crate that owns it:
   - tool-fs: `Glob` and `Grep` give a `display` whose paths are relative
     inside `cx.cwd` (`~` for home outside it); the model's text is
     unchanged and still absolute (R1).
   - tool-bash: a clean call's display holds the output alone; a non-zero
     one ends with `exit N`; a killed one ends with what stopped it; the
     model's text keeps `$ <command>` and `[Exited with code N]` (R2).
   - tool-bash: `preview()` is `Preview::Command { command, cwd,
     description }` (R4).
   - sdk: a `Preview::Command` without `description` reads unchanged from
     today's fixture; one with it round-trips (R4).
   - core: `/status` groups digits: `13,812 of 191,808 tokens (7 %) ·
     compacts at 172,627`, and `tokens  54,811 in · 139 out` (R7).
   - TUI: one `count(n)` gives `812`, `1.2k`, `13k`, `1.2M` (R5); the
     paths test `/var/folders/x/T/tmp.a/cwd` elides to `/var/…/tmp.a/cwd`,
     keeping the root segment (R9).
2. **Results the person reads** (R1, R2). tool-fs `glob.rs` and `grep.rs`
   set `display: View::Text` of the relative lines. tool-bash
   `output.rs` sets `display` beside `shape`'s model text, by the rule
   `transcript/ran.rs` already draws a person's `!` line by. In the TUI,
   a `View::Text` drawn as a tool's result wears `dim`, as the plain text
   it stands for does (tui.md §4, *result*); list the snapshots this
   moves.
3. **The receipt says only what is news** (R3). `transcript.rs`
   `receipt()` draws nothing for a person's plain allow; `allowed for this
   session` and `denied — <feedback>` stay. The item is unchanged; this is
   drawing only. tui.md §4 *receipt* gets the dated rule.
4. **The card asks a sentence** (R4). sdk `event/interaction.rs` `Preview::Command` gains
   `description: Option<String>` (serde default, skipped when `None`;
   schema regenerated by its generator). tool-bash implements `preview()`
   with the input's `description`. `dialog.rs` `question()`: a command
   preview asks `Do you want to run this command?` with the command on
   its tint and the description dim above it; a url preview asks `Do you
   want to fetch this page?`; a diff keeps the summary sentence; with no
   preview the sentence is `Do you want to allow <Tool> <target>?` —
   `opening()`'s lowercasing goes, so a tool's name is never made a verb.
5. **One count** (R5, R10). `count()` in the TUI's formatting module
   replaces `activity::spent`, `tree.rs`'s and `status.rs`'s own. A child
   row and a list row say what the session wrote, `↓ 8.1k`, as the
   activity row does (`usage.output_tokens`), never input re-counted per
   request; the status line keeps the window, `13k/191k`. tui.md §4
   *child row* and *the list* get the dated rule.
6. **The drawing notice** (R6). `run.rs` `slow_draw`: no notice in a
   debug build, where it is expected; in a release build it is `Info`
   (dim), once a run. Its words lose "a debug build".
7. **Commands describe themselves** (R8). `CommandSpec.hint` is the one
   line a person reads in the `/` menu: every spec whose hint is a
   synopsis (`core/commands/mod.rs` `spec`, `bingo-permissions`
   `command.rs`, `bingo-tool-bash` `shell.rs`) gets a description, and
   free-text synopses move to `args` (`ArgSpec::Free { hint }`); existing
   `Words`/`Catalog` completion remains typed (M100). `/quit` becomes an alias of `/exit`
   (`commands.rs`). The `?` sheet (`view.rs`, `keys.rs`) draws the keys
   alone, grouped *write · move · turn · sessions*, closed by one dim row
   `/ for commands · ! for a shell line`; no binding text is clipped at
   100 columns (shorten the words, never the meaning).
8. **The root segment** (R9). `paths.rs` `elide` keeps the first segment
   of an absolute path.
9. **Records.** tui.md §10 gets one dated entry naming R1–R10;
   tui-identity §2 ticks them.

## Re-verified at 3bf61ff5 (2026-10-14)

- M123 rule 4f still holds; result displays remain producer-owned. `Row`
  has `caption`; M125 focus/render and M135 lifecycle vocabulary stay intact.
- `Preview` moved to `event/interaction.rs`; no edit to `event.rs` is needed.
- Counts live in activity/tree/status; roster delegates to tree. Rename the
  work-summary helpers as the duplicated count formatters are removed.
- Core synopsis hints: compact/login/logout/model/models/plugins/rename/think;
  status needs a description. Preserve all Words/Catalog completion contracts.
- Share path shortening in tool-fs `path.rs`; Grep formats path prefixes before
  joining content, so matched text is never rewritten. No new dependency.
- M147 has no proposed ADR to accept. ADR-0070 remains the placement contract.
- Use an isolated tmux socket for the smoke/drive; run no live credentials.
- Full gate output is pasted in Verified as requested, even above 150 lines.

## Exit criteria

- [x] Each new-behavior regression failed first (output pasted) and passes
      now; the legacy preview compatibility control stayed green.
- [x] A tmux drive (fake provider, 120×40 and 80×24) shows: a `Glob`
      result relative to the cwd; a `Bash` result with no `$` line and no
      `[Exited with code 0]`; no `⎿  allowed`; the card `Do you want to
      run this command?` over the command and its description; `↓ 12`
      on the activity row early in a turn; no drawing notice in a debug
      build; `?` with no command rows; `/status` with grouped digits.
- [x] `rg 'fn spent|:\.1\}k|pub fn count\(n' crates/bingo-surface-tui/src` finds only
      `count`.
- [x] Every changed snapshot is listed below with its defect.
- [x] `scripts/tui-smoke.sh` passes; its `Do you want to ` needle holds.
- [x] All gates of the upgrade protocol, and the Windows cross-check for
      every touched crate (five C-header deferrals below, per step 7).

## Non-goals

- A session-wide answer for a compound shell command: `scope::narrowest`
  stays fail-closed (`split::is_simple`).
- Inline code's backticks (M73's choice), the fence's language row
  (M149), the welcome's words (M149), the rail and the panel sheet (M148).
- `--print` and channels: they draw the model text and keep it.

## Risks

- R2 changes what a person sees of every `Bash` call. The model text is
  pinned by `bingo-tool-bash` `lib.rs` tests and must not move.
- The dim rule for a `View::Text` result touches plugin displays too
  (demo-ui, jobs). That is tui.md's rule already; list the snapshots.
- Re-verify at start: the M123 rule 4f, the `Row`/`caption` shape after
  M123, `spent`'s callers, and the specs whose hint is a synopsis.

## Verified (2026-10-14)

Completed R1–R10. No new dependency, ADR change, live/credential test,
push, merge or PR. The branch is `m147-the-rough-edges`.

Final local gates passed: fmt, workspace check, clippy with `-D warnings`,
workspace tests (the three ACP token tests run separately with one thread),
discipline, budget, deny, terminal smoke, and the two-size tmux drive.
The final workspace run includes 1,135 passing TUI tests and two pre-existing
ignored tests. Budget is 355 dependencies; `target/debug` is 6 GB against a
5 GB soft limit. No shared build cache was deleted.

Windows: SDK, core and tool-bash passed. The following checks are deferred to
Windows CI under protocol step 7; no Rust compile error appeared:

| Crate | C build blocked by missing Windows SDK headers |
|---|---|
| bingo-tool-fs | aws-lc-sys: stdlib.h, windows.h |
| bingo-permissions | tree-sitter, tree-sitter-bash: stdio.h, stdlib.h |
| bingo-channel-adapter | aws-lc-sys: stdlib.h, windows.h |
| bingo-surface-tui | aws-lc-sys: stdlib.h, windows.h |
| bingo | aws-lc-sys, tree-sitter, tree-sitter-bash: stdio.h, stdlib.h, windows.h |

Corrections during gates stayed within Files: regenerate the command-hint
schema description; move the 80×24 help assertions from `screens.rs` to
`keys.rs` to meet its file-size limit; shorten the compact hint so the kernel
noun guard does not match “room”. The full failed and passing gate outputs
are retained below. No protocol stop condition remains.

The smoke script used a private tmux socket through the shim below. Both
drive sizes used the fake provider and temporary homes; the drive removed
provider key variables. Only harness-owned tmux processes were controlled.
All temporary drive homes and tmux servers were cleaned up.

Smoke socket shim (`/tmp/bingo-m147-bin/tmux`):

```bash
#!/bin/bash
# Keep the smoke script on a socket created only for this milestone.
if [[ "$1" == -L && "$2" == bingo ]]; then
  shift 2
  exec /opt/homebrew/bin/tmux -L bingo-m147-smoke-0b59ee78634342ca8121ea54a34c35a0 "$@"
fi
exec /opt/homebrew/bin/tmux "$@"
```

Focused drive (`/tmp/bingo-m147-drive.py`):

```python
import json, os, pathlib, re, shlex, subprocess, tempfile, time
ROOT = pathlib.Path.cwd()
SOCKET = f'bingo-m147-drive-{os.getpid()}'
TMUX = '/opt/homebrew/bin/tmux'
def tmux(*args):
    return subprocess.check_output([TMUX, '-L', SOCKET, *args], text=True, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
def pane():
    return tmux('capture-pane', '-p', '-t', 'drive')
def key(*args):
    tmux('send-keys', '-t', 'drive', *args)
def wait_for(needle, timeout=20):
    until=time.monotonic()+timeout
    while time.monotonic()<until:
        text=pane()
        if needle in text: return text
        time.sleep(.05)
    raise AssertionError(f'waiting for {needle}:\n{pane()}')
def capture(label):
    print(f'\n{label}\n{pane()}', flush=True)
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='bingo-m147-drive-') as tmp:
    work=pathlib.Path(tmp)
    try:
        for width,height in [(120,40),(80,24)]:
            base=work/str(width); home=base/'home'; cwd=base/'cwd'
            (home/'.bingo').mkdir(parents=True); cwd.mkdir()
            (home/'.bingo/settings.json').write_text(json.dumps({'update':{'check':False}}))
            (cwd/'main.rs').write_text('fn main() {}\n')
            args={'pattern':'*.rs'}
            prose='Inspecting sources'.ljust(48-len(json.dumps(args,separators=(',',':'))),'.')
            script=base/'script.json'
            script.write_text(json.dumps({'responses':[
                {'steps':[{'text':prose},{'toolCall':{'name':'Glob','input':args}}]},
                {'steps':[{'delayBeforeStream':{'ms':5000}},{'toolCall':{'name':'Bash','input':{'command':'sleep 1; echo m147-done','description':'Print the local smoke marker'}}}]},
                {'steps':[{'text':'Rough-edge drive complete.'}]}
            ]}))
            command=['env','-u','ANTHROPIC_API_KEY','-u','OPENAI_API_KEY',f'HOME={home}',f'USERPROFILE={home}',f'BINGO_FAKE_SCRIPT={script}',str(ROOT/'target/debug/bingo'),'--cwd',str(cwd)]
            tmux('-f','/dev/null','new-session','-d','-s','drive','-x',str(width),'-y',str(height),shlex.join(command))
            wait_for('? for shortcuts')
            key('-l','check local source and print the smoke marker'); key('Enter')
            wait_for('↓ 12')
            capture(f'{width}x{height}: relative Glob and early count')
            text=pane(); assert re.search(r'⎿\s+main.rs',text),text
            wait_for('Do you want to run this command?')
            text=wait_for('Print the local smoke marker'); capture(f'{width}x{height}: command preview')
            assert '$ sleep 1; echo m147-done' in text,text
            for _ in range(30):
                key('y'); time.sleep(.1)
                if 'Do you want to run this command?' not in pane():break
            text=wait_for('Rough-edge drive complete.')
            capture(f'{width}x{height}: clean output and no receipt')
            assert not any(bad in text for bad in ['$ sleep','[Exited with code 0]','⎿  allowed','drawing took']),text
            key('-l','?'); text=wait_for('/ for commands · ! for a shell line')
            capture(f'{width}x{height}: grouped shortcuts')
            assert '/quit' not in text and '/status' not in text,text
            key('Escape');key('-l','/status');key('Enter')
            text=wait_for('compacts at');capture(f'{width}x{height}: grouped status')
            assert re.search(r'\d,\d{3}',text),text
            key('C-c');key('C-c')
            # This server has only the process started by this harness.
            subprocess.run([TMUX,'-L',SOCKET,'kill-server'],stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL,stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL)
        print('M147 tmux drive passed at 120x40 and 80x24.',flush=True)
    finally:
        subprocess.run([TMUX,'-L',SOCKET,'kill-server'],stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL,stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL)
```

```text
  a reply reaches the transcript
```
